correctness.rationale: For every b>=3 and k>=1, gap indices between successive 1s have exactly (b-2)b^{v2(j)} zeros. The unique largest central gap handles zero-only and one-one factors. Multi-one factors transfer by unique maximal internal two-adic gap to one of two canonical copies, with explicit exterior-padding comparisons and a k=2 boundary case. A set of k pairwise disjoint all-occurrence factor supports gives the matching lower bound for k>=3, and two disjoint supports for k=1,2. The independent exact finite checker fully enumerated 264990 distinct factors across 23 test words and confirmed both bounds. Its finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The minimum size and explicit optimal attractor of a natural fractal automatic-word family are determined for every base and level. The exact base-independent k-law sharpens known logarithmic-profile estimates in the same ternary Cantor word, and its proof identifies a transferable gap structure and matching non-overlap obstruction. This is a uniform infinite classification, not an arbitrary finite slice.
